note: The ladder rules agreed the morning of 9/17. The band lines moved from 15, 50 and 85 to 10, 60 and 75 on 9/20 after the cut-point study on real prices since 2020 (tools/ladder_cutpoints_study.py). The Ladder tab renders this file; the monitor's pushes carry the same plays. Edit here, not in index.html.

rules.rule: New longs only with BTC's daily close above its 50 day. Below it no new money enters. Open positions keep their own exits.
Under 10 uses MSTX. 10 to 60 uses MSTR. 60 to 75 uses IBIT. 75 and up is the sell zone. Rotate bands only on monthly closes. A touch does not trigger rotation.
Buy 12 months and sell 90 days. Roll the short leg.
Buy 0.75 delta and sell the band ceiling. Carry the ceiling to the short expiry. MSTX uses the 10 line. Enter that BTC price in BITCOIN PRICE LOOKUP. Set the short expiry to get the strike.
Enter at zero gap or below while Rich is off. Cheap is the add. Never open a primary while Rich is on.
Size the primary by phase. Use 80% of the sleeve on 9/17. Use 70% on 9/26. Use 60% at LEAPS and after. Keep two 10% gap sleeves and a growing cash floor.

Exit when the monthly close crosses the band. The short strike is the trigger. When the gate flips down roll the short call lower and closer. Use 30 to 45 days. Keep the long. At the 75 line sell the BTC beta and rotate down.

phase_note: Phase 2 (Jan long / Dec 18 short, decided 9/15) stays as written at 70%. The time and strike rules bind from Phase 3, the LEAPS, on.

history.tops_note: The peaks step down. On a monthly close the 2024-25 top never reached 85. It closed above the 75 line twice, 2024-11 and 2025-01, both near quantile 78 on the site's own function. The 75 line is where the BTC beta gets sold, not a place to sit. The peak_q list predates the 9/20 line move and its basis was not rechecked.
